name: Soda Pop
blurb: The demon boy band Saja Boys' debut song in KPop Demon Hunters, a TikTok dance hit
title: Soda Pop by Saja Boys: Why the KPop Demon Hunters Song Went Viral
description: "Soda Pop" is the debut song of Saja Boys, the demon boy band in Netflix's KPop Demon Hunters. Its catchy chorus and choreography became a TikTok dance trend in 2025.
answer: "Soda Pop" is the introduction song of the Saja Boys, the villainous demon boy band in Netflix's animated film KPop Demon Hunters, released with the soundtrack on 20 June 2025. It is sung by Andrew Choi, Neckwav, Danny Chung, Kevin Woo and samUIL Lee. Its bubbly chorus and the group's choreography turned into a TikTok dance trend joined by fans, kids and real K-pop idols, and the song peaked at No. 3 on the Billboard Hot 100.

body: The trend copies the Saja Boys' stage routine from the film: sharp, synchronised boy-band moves on the chorus, performed by fans in bedrooms, dance studios and in public. Mirrored and slowed-down tutorials spread within days of the film's release, K-pop idols posted their own versions, and BTS's j-hope joined with a clip of his backup dancers backstage at Lollapalooza. Many videos feature children, for whom the song became a playground favourite.

head: Date
Event
rows: KPop Demon Hunters and its soundtrack, including "Soda Pop", are released on Netflix.
Dance tutorials and challenge videos start spreading on TikTok.
Peaks at No. 3 on the Billboard Global 200 (week of 9 August) and on the UK Singles Chart.
Released as a promotional single through Republic Records.
Peaks at No. 3 on the Billboard Hot 100 (week of 4 October).

body: In the film, the Saja Boys are demons sent by the demon king Gwi-Ma to steal fans from the girl group HUNTR/X and weaken the magic barrier that protects humans. "Soda Pop" is their charm offensive: the singers compare themselves to a fizzy, sweet drink you cannot stop wanting, which is the joke, since the sweetness is a trap.

body.note: "Saja" echoes jeoseung saja, the grim-reaper figure of Korean folklore, and also sounds like the Korean word for lion, which is why the group's logo is a lion head. The song began years earlier as a guitar demo called "Ice Cream" by co-writer Vince.

ul: Billboard Hot 100: peak No. 3. Billboard Global 200: peak No. 3.
UK Singles Chart: peak No. 3; top 10 in at least 18 countries.
Platinum in the US and UK.
TikTok Korea named it the No. 1 Song of the Summer of 2025.

faq.a: Andrew Choi (singing voice of Jinu), Neckwav, Danny Chung, Kevin Woo and samUIL Lee, credited as the Saja Boys.

faq.q: How do you do the Soda Pop dance?
faq.a: Most TikTok versions teach the chorus: crisp boy-band steps with hand gestures and body rolls hit exactly on the beat. Searching for a mirrored tutorial is the easiest way to learn it.

faq.q: Are the Saja Boys a real band?
faq.a: No. They are fictional demons from the film, but the five singers are real and some have performed the song live.
